qa.question: I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. If that Digimon is already unsuspended, does an effect that reads "unsuspend 1 of your Digimon" activate this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: No. If an effect unsuspends a card that's already unsuspended, it doesn't count as unsuspending it.

qa.question: I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. If that Digimon is already unsuspended, does this card's inherited effect activate during my unsuspend phase?
qa.answer: No. If an effect unsuspends a card that's already unsuspended, it doesn't count as unsuspending it.

qa.question: What counts as "another Digimon in play with the same name as this Digimon"? Does this only count if I have another Digimon in play named [Tsumemon]?
qa.answer: No. This effect doesn't refer to [Tsumemon], but to the name of the Digimon this card digivolves into.

qa.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this Digimon's effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes. Even if this Digimon is blocked, the effect activates if you declared an attack against your opponent.

qa.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this Digimon's effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes. Even if this Digimon is blocked, the effect activates if you declared an attack against your opponent.

qa.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this Digimon's effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes. Even if this Digimon is blocked, the effect activates if you declared an attack against your opponent.

qa.question: I use this card's When Attacking effect to trash my opponent's Security Cards. Do the security effects on those cards activate?
qa.answer: No. They weren't flipped over in a security check, so they don't activate.

qa.question: My opponent has 1 or more cards in their security stack. I attack my opponent with this Digimon and its When Attacking effect trashes the rest of their security cards, leaving them with zero cards in their security stack. If the attack isn't blocked and my attack is successful when they have zero cards in their security stack, do I win the game?
qa.answer: Yes, you do.

qa.question: If my opponent uses a card like [BT2-020 Gallantmon] to trash a card in my security directly, can I activate this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. If that Digimon is already unsuspended, does an effect that reads "unsuspend 1 of your Digimon" activate this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: No. If an effect unsuspends a card that's already unsuspended, it doesn't count as unsuspending it.

qa.question: My opponent has 5 or more Digimon with no digivolution cards in play, meaning this card's effect reduces its cost by 5, to -1. Can I play it by gaining a memory?
qa.answer: No, play costs can't be reduced to less than zero. You can play the card for free, but you can't gain memory with effects that reduce play costs.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to unsuspend this card if it digivolves while suspended?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. If that Digimon is already unsuspended, does an effect that reads "unsuspend 1 of your Digimon" activate this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: No. If an effect unsuspends a card that's already unsuspended, it doesn't count as unsuspending it.

qa.question: "This Digimon can't be blocked by your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards." How does this effect work, exactly?
qa.answer: This Digimon's attacks can't be blocked by your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards.

qa.question: "This Digimon can't be blocked by your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards." How does this effect work, exactly?
qa.answer: This Digimon's attacks can't be blocked by your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards.

qa.question: Can I use this Digimon's effect to suspend one of my blue Tamers?
qa.answer: No, you can't use this Digimon's effect to suspend your blue Tamers. The effect only allows you to unsuspend this Digimon when another effect suspends one of your blue Tamers.

qa.question: If this Digimon is unsuspended during my main phase, does an effect that reads "unsuspend 1 of your Digimon" activate this card's "gain 1 memory" effect?
qa.answer: No. If an effect unsuspends a card that's already unsuspended, it doesn't count as unsuspending it.

qa.question: I have 3 cards in my security stack when 2 copies of this Digimon are deleted at the same time. Do the [On Deletion] effects on both cards activate, bringing my security stack up to 5 cards?
qa.answer: No. Even if both Digimon are deleted simultaneously, the effects activate one at a time. When the first Salamon's effect activates, you add 1 card to your security stack, bringing the total up to 4. This means the "3 cards or less" condition for the second Salamon's effect no longer applies. The second Salamon's effect doesn't activate, and your security stack remains at 4 cards.

qa.question: Do I have to activate this card's [When Attacking] effect every time I attack with it?
qa.answer: No, you can choose.

qa.question: If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to play a Digimon card with an [On Play] effect, does that [On Play] effect activate when the Digimon enters play?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: When I place this card face down on top of my security stack because of its effect, does it become a security card?
qa.answer: Yes, it does. During checks, it will fight your opponent's attacking Digimon as a Security Digimon.

qa.question: I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to suspend 2 or more yellow Tamers. Can I choose 2 or more of my opponent's Digimon and give all of them -4000 DP?
qa.answer: Yes, the [When Evolving] effect activates separately for each yellow Tamer you suspend, and you get to choose the target for each effect.

qa.question: I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect two or more times. Are they treated as activating at separate timings?
qa.answer: No, they're treated as activating at the same timing.

qa.question: If my opponent uses the effect on a card like [BT2-041 ShineGreymon] to suspend 2 or more of their Tamers, does this card's inherited effect allow me to gain a memory for each Tamer suspended?
qa.answer: No. Even if your opponent suspends multiple Tamers simultaneously, this card's inherited effect treats all of it as a single timing instance, so you only gain 1 memory.

qa.question: If the 3 cards I reveal with this card's effect don't contain both a level 5 Digimon card and a green Tamer card, do I still get to add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes. If either a level 5 Digimon card or a green Tamer card are present in the 3 cards you reveal, you get to add it to your hand.

qa.question: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card and 1 green Tamer card.

qa.question: If I use this card's inherited effect to play a Digimon card with an [On Play] effect, does that [On Play] effect activate when the Digimon enters play?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: I use this card's [On Play] effect to suspend an opponent's Digimon. Is that Digimon the only one that doesn't unsuspend during my opponent's next unsuspend phase?
qa.answer: No. The Digimon suspended by this effect -- along with all of your opponent's other suspended Digimon -- remain suspended during their unsuspend phase.

qa.question: Does this card's [On Play] effect cause my opponent's unsuspended Digimon to suspend themselves during their next unsuspend phase?
qa.answer: No. It only prevents suspended Digimon from unsuspending. Any unsuspended Digimon remain that way.

qa.question: Does this card's [On Play] effect prevent my opponent's suspended Tamers from unsuspending during their next unsuspend phase?
qa.answer: No, the effect doesn't affect Tamers. They unsuspend as normal.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to attack an opponent's unsuspended Digimon. Does the opponent's Digimon suspend itself?
qa.answer: No, it remains unsuspended during the battle.

qa.question: What counts as "another Digimon with the same name as this Digimon"? Does this only count if I have another Digimon in play named [Keramon]?
qa.answer: No. This effect doesn't refer to [Keramon], but to the name of the Digimon this card digivolves into.

qa.question: Does the inherited effect on a card like BT2-059 [Kurisarimon] or BT2-053 [Keramon] trigger twice when I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play 2 [Diaboromon] Tokens?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't.
You can play 2 [Diaboromon] Tokens, but they are played at the same time during a single timing, therefore the effect only triggers once.

qa.question: What counts as "another Digimon with the same name as this Digimon"? Does this only count if I have another Digimon in play named [Kurisarimon]?
qa.answer: No. This effect doesn't refer to [Kurisarimon], but to the name of the Digimon this card digivolves into.

qa.question: Does the inherited effect on a card like BT2-059 [Kurisarimon] or BT2-053 [Keramon] trigger twice when I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play 2 [Diaboromon] Tokens?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't.
You can play 2 [Diaboromon] Tokens, but they are played at the same time during a single timing, therefore the effect only triggers once.

qa.question: This Digimon is in my breeding area when I digivolve it into a Diaboromon from my hand. Does this card's effect activate?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't activate from breeding areas.

qa.question: If 2 or more of my other Digimon are deleted at the same time, can I gain 2 memory?
qa.answer: No. This inherited effect only allows you to gain 1 memory per turn, no matter how many Digimon are deleted.

qa.question: Do I have to activate this card's effect?
qa.answer: No, you may choose not to use it.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to delete a Digimon in my breeding area?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to delete a Digimon in my breeding area?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: What's a token?
qa.answer: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays a token that's treated as a Digimon named [Diaboromon]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect by deleting a [Diaboromon] token when this Digimon is about to be deleted?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when one of my [Diaboromon] tokens is about to be deleted?
qa.answer: No. this card's [All Turns] effect only takes effect when this Digimon is deleted. You can't activate it when a [Diaboromon] token is deleted.

qa.question: I have this Digimon and a [Diaboromon] token in play in my battle area when my opponent uses [BT1-084 Omnimon]'s [On Evolution] effect to choose [Diaboromon]. Are this Digimon and my [Diaboromon] token both deleted due to having the same name?
qa.answer: Yes. The token is considered a Digimon with the specified name, and is deleted.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when this Digimon is about to be deleted in a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: When playing this card from my trash using its [On Deletion] effect, do the cards it had as digivolution cards return to my battle area as well?
qa.answer: No, this card's [On Deletion] effect only returns this card to play. Any cards that were in its digivolution cards go to the trash.

qa.question: I attack my opponent with a Digimon, and suspend this Tamer. If my opponent blocks the attack, what happens to the +2000 DP bonus from this Tamer's effect?
qa.answer: This Tamer's effect becomes active once you declare your attack against another player. The +2000 DP bonus remains even if the target of attack changes due to <Blocker>.

qa.question: You activate an effect that reads "Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to their hand. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon" to return an opponent's Digimon to their hand. When your opponent's digivolution cards are trashed as a result, can you activate this card's effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't. "Trash all of the digivolution cards of those Digimon" is an explanation of what happens to the digivolution cards of the Digimon when it returns to their hand. It doesn't count as trashing digivolution for the purposes of this card's effect.

qa.question: I digivolve a Digimon in my breeding area into a Digimon card with [Tyrannomon] in its name. Can I use this Tamer's effect to reduce the digivolution cost by 1?
qa.answer: No, digivolving Digimon in your breeding area doesn't activate the effect that reduces digivolution cost by 1.

qa.question: What cards are returned to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: 1 purple Digimon card or 1 purple Option card.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: If I have 2 or more cards in hand when I use this effect, can I give 2 or more different Digimon -1000 DP?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect can only be activated against 1 of your opponent's Digimon. You can't use a single copy of this card to reduce the DP of multiple Digimon.

qa.question: Can I use option cards that can change their cost to 7 on certain conditions such as [BT7-100 Qualialise Blast] or [BT11-108 DG Dimension] with this card’s [On Play] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can’t. Since those options are cards that have effects that “reduce the cost by…” or “its memory cost is equal to…” when they would be used, their cost has not actually changed when activating this card’s [On Play] effect, so they can’t be used with this card’s effect.
However, since [BT2-099 Glorious Burst] always has the effect of reducing its use cost when used from the hand, if you have 2 yellow Tamers, it can be used with this card’s effect as its use cost will be 7.

qa.question: An Option card's use cost is 1 or less when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. When such a card is used, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If a card's cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand, it's considered to be using an Option card with a use cost after the reduction is applied. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect doesn't trigger.

qa.question: A card's cost is 0 when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. When such a card is used, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 1 or more" effect trigger?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If a card's cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand, it's considered to be using an Option card with a use cost after the reduction is applied. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 1 or more" effect doesn't trigger.

qa.question: An Option card's use cost is 5 or less when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place that card as a security card?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If a card's use cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand and the use cost is 5 or less, this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect can place that card as a security card.

qa.question: I attack my opponent with this Digimon and flip over [BT2-105 Spider Shooter] during the security check. The <De-Digivolve> trashes this card. Does this card’s [End of Attack] effect activate?
qa.answer: No. This card is no longer in play at the end of the attack, so the [End of Attack] effect doesn't activate.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to delete a Digimon in my breeding area?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: If I have 10 or more cards in my trash, can I digivolve one of my [Impmon] in the breeding area into this card?
qa.answer: No, you can't use this card's effect to digivolve from an [Impmon] in your breeding area.

qa.question: If I have 10 or more cards in my trash, can I digivolve one of my [Impmon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I use effects like [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s "digivolve into this card in your hand for a memory cost of X, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements" effect?
qa.answer: Yes. [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s effect doesn't reduce digivolution costs--it allows you to ignore digivolution requirements and digivolve for a specific memory cost, so you can still activate it.

qa.question: I have 10 or more cards in my trash. Can I use this card’s <Delay> effect to digivolve my [Impmon] into [BT2-111 Beelzemon] in my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: This card's [When Attacking] effect refers to "your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP." Does this strictly refer to my opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, or does it refer to when I attack an opponent's Digimon with the highest DP out of all Digimon in play, including my own?
qa.answer: It refers strictly to your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP they control. The effect doesn't check the DP of your Digimon.

qa.question: My opponent has multiple Digimon tied for highest DP. If I attack any one of them, does this card's [When Attacking] effect let me unsuspend this Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes. If your opponent has multiple Digimon tied for highest DP, attacking any of them allows you to unsuspend this Digimon.

qa.question: My opponent's Digimon with the highest DP is unsuspended. If I attack their unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP, can I unsuspend this Digimon?
qa.answer: No, this Digimon's [When Attacking] effect only lets you unsuspend this Digimon when attacking your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, regardless of whether it's suspended or not.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0225.title: <Piercing>
comprehensive-0225.text:
16-7. <Piercing>
16-7-1. <Piercing> is a keyword effect that reads "When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends." (For details, refer to 13 "Security Checks")
16-7-2. <Piercing> is a trigger-type effect that triggers and activates when a Digimon with this effect battles an opponent's Digimon and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger- Type Effects")
16-7-3. The security check from using <Piercing> is mandatory.
16-7-4. <Piercing> is pending processing that is processed immediately before the transition to the end of attack timing. Therefore, it will trigger simultaneously with effects triggered by the battle, but it is processed before the end of the attack. (Example: If a Digimon with <Piercing> attacks and deletes a Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect in the battle, first the [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then <Piercing> is processed.)
16-7-5. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of cards that can be checked by the attacking Digimon is modified, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
16-7-6. If there are no Digimon to perform a security check at the point when <Piercing> is processed, a security check won't be possible.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0227.title: <Jamming>
comprehensive-0227.text:
16-9. <Jamming>
16-9-1. <Jamming> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect isn't deleted as a result of a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon.
16-9-2. <Jamming> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0228.title: <Digisorption>
comprehensive-0228.text:
16-10. <Digisorption>
16-10-1. <Digisorption> is a keyword effect. When a digivolution into a Digimon card with this effect in the hand would occur, by suspending 1 of your Digimon, the digivolution cost is reduced according to the value specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Digisorption -3>.
16-10-2. <Digisorption> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when a digivolution into a card with this effect in the hand would occur. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-10-3. "By suspending 1 of your Digimon" in <Digisorption> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "the digivolution cost is reduced" will be mandatory.
16-10-4. If 1 Digimon card has multiple instances of <Digisorption>, they overlap when they trigger.37 Multiple instances of <Digisorption> can be activated for a single digivolution.
16-10-5. <Digisorption> can be used to suspend a Digimon that will become a digivolution card.

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.
